# Token Meter Review Contract

Review the requested behavior against the current base-to-head diff. Report findings
first, ordered by severity, with tight file and line evidence. Do not modify tracked
files while acting as reviewer.

## Gate

- Low-risk fast path: no independent tester or reviewer. The coordinator must record
  the selected allowed change kind, explicit eligibility, focused evidence, and
  unverified checks. Any disqualifying risk or escalation condition moves the work to
  the standard gate.
- Standard code change: one independent tester and one independent project reviewer.
- High-risk change: one independent tester and at least two project reviewers with
  distinct lenses.
- Hosted Codex or Claude reviews are advisory and do not satisfy the project minimum.
- Every result is bound to the reviewed head. A tracked code or test change invalidates
  older verification and review evidence.

High-risk categories are defined in `.agents/workflow/review-policy.yaml` and include
privacy, pricing, parsing, deletion, persistence, staged runtime and installer work,
native behavior, cross-platform behavior, and shared helpers.

## Required lenses

Select the lenses that can change the verdict:

- Acceptance-criteria and requirement coverage.
- Correctness, failures, empty data, stale data, concurrency, and upgrade behavior.
- Callers and consumers of changed or removed helpers.
- Backend, dashboard, native menu, installer, and staged-runtime parity.
- Runtime/provider identity and measured-versus-estimated semantics.
- Local-only privacy boundaries and sanitized public projections.
- Compatibility routes, stored settings, migrations, and platform behavior.
- Test quality, including synthetic fixtures that may not represent upstream data.
- Maintainability only where it creates a concrete correctness or regression risk.

## Findings ledger

Use `blocking`, `important`, or `minor`. Each finding contains an identifier, concise
summary, evidence, owner, and one disposition: fixed, disproved, accepted by the
owner, or externally blocked. Verify external-review claims before accepting or fixing
them. Do not invent findings to avoid returning an empty ledger.

Readiness is blocked until every blocking or important finding is dispositioned and
required verification is fresh for the reviewed head. Minor findings remain visible
but do not block unless the review policy for the work item says otherwise.
